body.message:
We sincerely apologize for any confusion and inconvenience this may have caused.

We would like to kindly inform you that, due to an unexpected system glitch, in the booking.com platform the listing incorrectly displays 1 King Bed. However, as shown clearly in the property photos, the apartment is furnished with 2 Single Beds.

We sincerely regret this error. Thank you for your understanding and patience.
